events.body: DL-7031 (Tallowmere TG-7072) attempt 1 logged 18:41. Reason code: no answer. Booked slot was 12:00-14:00. Photo on file: parcel on block paving, no door or house number in frame. Stop record not reviewed.

I've just had a text to say you 'tried to deliver' my hedge trimmer at 18:41. How thoughtful. I was in all day for the 12 to 2 slot and watched two Saltmarrow Arc vans go past the end of the close without slowing down. Nobody came at 18:41 either, I was sat ten feet from the door. The photo attached to the text is a box on some paving. Could be anywhere. Could be the moon.
DL-7031: the recipient, Piran Oakshott, says she was home through the 12:00-14:00 slot and at 18:41 and that nobody called. Please rebook the delivery for tomorrow and confirm the slot to her.

events.to: Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk; Piran Oakshott, recipient

events.from: Ianthe Haverly, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the parcel for DL-7031 was actually left in the bin store yesterday, so you can mark this closed.

DL-7031 attempt 2 logged 16:52. Reason code: no answer. Photo on file: parcel held up in front of a terraced row with a blue shop awning. Not checked against the delivery address. Stop record not reviewed.

DL-7031 now has 2 failed attempts. It goes out a third time tomorrow, 4 June. After a third failed attempt a parcel is returned to the merchant automatically on the next trunk, which would be 06:00 on 5 June. We apply the count as it is logged and cannot change it. Only Delivery investigations can review a stop record and void an attempt. Disputed attempts go to them by email with the recipient's account, not to us.

Day two of the magic trick. Apparently I was 'not in' again at 16:52, which is fascinating because I was weeding the front border at the time. Today's photo is my parcel being held up outside a shop with a blue awning. I live on a cul-de-sac of nine bungalows. There is no shop, no awning and no terrace within a mile of here. My doorbell camera recorded from 7 till 7 both days and its entire cast is the postman, next door's cat and me. I can send you both days if anyone is interested in what actually happened as opposed to what your carrier's driver has typed in. And now I get a text saying 'two attempts made, one remaining before your parcel is returned'. Attempts at what, exactly? Somebody is making these up and you lot are filing it as fact.

Honestly this delay is killing me, ha.
